_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Lucie, Lady Duff Gordon (1821-1869): Meinhold's The Amber Witch (1844) and The French in Algiers (1845). Her own Letters from Egypt and from the Cape are not translations and are not shelved here. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 19); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
